items.requirement: Invalid arithmetic (especially division or remainder by zero) fails with a named domain error, not an opaque language/runtime error.
items.rationale: Callers and contract tests need a stable failure signal.
items.threshold: Division/remainder by zero always raises the named domain error type used by the service (never ZeroDivisionError/raw runtime as the only signal).
items.measurement: OCL-derived Vitest contract tests + OpenAPI error channel exercises.
